definitions.explanation: Sturdy boots designed for hiking and mountain climbing, with features like ankle support and durable soles.

examples.japanese: {登山靴|とざんぐつ}は{足首|あしくび}をしっかり{支|ささ}える。
examples.english: Hiking boots firmly support the ankles.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{登山靴|とざんぐつ}を{履|は}き{慣|な}らす{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to break in new hiking boots.

examples.japanese: {防水|ぼうすい}の{登山靴|とざんぐつ}を{選|えら}んだ。

notes:
FORMATION:
{登山|とざん} (mountain climbing) + {靴|くつ}→ぐつ (shoes/boots)

Note: {靴|くつ} becomes {靴|ぐつ} (rendaku) in this compound.

TYPES:
・ハイカット (high-cut - for serious mountaineering)
・ミッドカット (mid-cut - versatile)
・ローカット (low-cut - for light hiking)

FEATURES:
・{防水|ぼうすい} (waterproof)
・{滑|すべ}り{止|ど}め (non-slip sole)
・ゴアテックス (Gore-Tex)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{登山靴|とざんぐつ}を{履|は}く (to wear hiking boots)
・{登山靴|とざんぐつ}を{履|は}き{慣|な}らす (to break in hiking boots)
